description: H0B research-status overlay. It keeps every M01–M11 intent and its declared source hash and revises the research status through an overlay, never by rewriting the old declarations.

policy.prior_identification_note: The P04 behavioural priors a legacy declaration references are UNIDENTIFIED model parameters (prior-constrained): no declared observable constrains them and they are recorded only as calibrated_parameter_dependencies, so a declaration may call its design 'declared' but never call its priors 'identified'. Any 'identified' sentence survives only as a revoked quotation.
policy.promotion_note: No r, .6/.7 or p threshold may raise a historical status, and SUPPORTED_MODEL_BEHAVIOR requires a complete pre-registered experiment with paired/first-stage/mediator/negative control/conservation evidence; HISTORICAL_SUPPORTED additionally requires admitted primary sources with an independent review of competing explanations.

observability_note: Every record's technical_registration.observability_in_reference_run is the genuine frequency of hsm_lab.evidence.adapter.observe_registry over this reference run, counted per legacy card; the per-card frequencies sum to metrics_total, the eleven cards sum to registered_metrics, and hsm_lab.evidence.adapter.observation_counts reports the identical global tally. The frequencies are an observability report, not a research status: they do not raise any record's structural or historical verdict.
